name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia fired 84 cruise missiles and 404 drones at Ukraine overnight on 20 Nov; 12 killed and 82 injured in a day
state: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 84 cruise missiles, 404 drones and ballistic missiles overnight into 20 Nov, mainly at energy targets, and that 462 were intercepted or suppressed (Kyiv Independent). Local authorities reported 12 killed and 82 injured across Ukraine over the day; three Kyiv bridges were damaged and power was cut (Kyiv Independent; AP via KSAT). Putin had vowed a response to attacks on the Kerch Bridge.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure can affect European energy markets.

sources.title: Kyiv Independent — Russian attacks kill 12, injure 82 across Ukraine over past day
